<p>Brace yourself for the 25th issue of the acclaimed horror anthology series Hello Darkness! Fans of the divine nunsploitation series Marian Heretic from writer Tini Howard are in for a treat as Marian herself makes her first return to the pages of Hello Darkness since the breakout series’ debut! This Marian Heretic four-parter revisits our favorite heathen as she doles out judgment to a whole new host of supernatural opponents. Then, following the mysterious loss of his son, a father’s attempt to cope takes him on a twisted journey, raising questions for him and his grieving family in “The Hole” written by Robert Menegus with art by Jonathan Marks!</p>
